english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that happens or is true every time.
Use this when constantly means always or invariably being the case.

examples.english: When the weather turns cold, I invariably can't resist having hot pot.
examples.traditional: 天氣一凍，我總係忍唔住要食打邊爐。
examples.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jat1 dung3 ngo5 zung2 hai6 jan2 m4 zyu6 jiu3 sik6 daa2 bin1 lou4

examples.english: They are constantly late and never on time.
examples.traditional: 佢總係遲到，從來都唔會準時。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zung2 hai6 ci4 dou3 cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 wui5 zeon2 si4
